source: European Central Bank, euro foreign exchange reference rates (Pound sterling, GBP)
quote_convention: GBP per 1 EUR (ECB: 'All currencies quoted against the euro (base currency)'); to convert GBP to EUR divide GBP amounts by this rate
note: Converting GBP to EUR changes the currency only. Defra values stay in 2025 prices and EEA values in 2021 prices; the methodology page shows both.
